tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Open Creator Graph's FAQ and machine documentation (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, reuse terms) for questions about how records, confidence labels, AI consent, removals and reuse work.

tools.name: fetch_doc
tools.description: Read one documentation page in full, as Markdown. `path` is a path search_docs returned, or one of /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /license.txt, /faqs/, /for-ai-and-search/, /how-we-source/, /editorial-policy/, /about-this-record/, /why-the-graph-exists/, /for-creators/, /for-agencies/, /changelog/.
